description.value: Royal Seafood Restaurant is a full-service Chinese restaurant on the second floor of Garden City Centre shopping mall in Richmond, specializing in traditional Dim Sum and dinner. The restaurant is equipped for mid-sized banquet events including weddings, corporate gatherings, and themed evenings such as caviar tastings and wine pairings. Its chefs are described as hand-selected for their dedication to fresh, seasonal ingredients recognized among the best in Richmond and the Lower Mainland.
